pincode.description: You can lock the app with a pincode if you'd like. Be warned that the only way to reset a forgotten code is to erase all your data, so be careful not to forget.

lock_screen.confirm: Please re-enter your passcode to confirm.
lock_screen.reset_warning: If you reset your PIN, some local access may be affected.
lock_screen.wrong_pin: That PIN didn't match. Try again.
lock_screen.storage_error_body: FreeCBT couldn't check your app lock. Your private content remains hidden until you retry.
